name: card-select
prompt: A single playing card lifted and tapped once against a felt card table, soft crisp paper snap.

name: card-deselect
prompt: A playing card gently laid back down onto a small stack of cards, soft muted paper thud.

name: card-pickup
prompt: A playing card sliding off the top of a deck with a quick paper flick and light fingertip brush.

name: card-drop
prompt: A small stack of playing cards landing flat on a wooden table with a soft slap.

name: cell-store
prompt: A single playing card placed into an empty wooden slot, light click of the card edge against wood.

name: foundation-build
prompt: A playing card snapped crisply onto a neat squared pile, bright satisfying paper click.

name: move-invalid
prompt: A dull wooden block knocked once against a tabletop, short negative low thunk.

name: move-undo
prompt: A playing card slid quickly backwards across felt fabric, soft reversing swish.

name: hint-chime
prompt: A small brass desk bell tapped once gently, soft bright metallic ting.

name: lesson-step
prompt: Two small wooden beads clicked together in quick succession, gentle instructional cue.

name: deal-win
prompt: A cascade of playing cards riffled and fanned across a wooden table with a celebratory flourish, ending in a light hand clap.

name: deal-lose
prompt: A deck of playing cards slowly gathered and squared up on a wooden table, subdued closing shuffle.

name: achievement-unlock
prompt: A small brass trophy bell rung once with a bright clear sustained ring, celebratory desk chime.
